observations: Both pages viewed, four original train contexts: two fitted and two from unused train scenes. After24 depth shows a clearer near-to-far road gradient and greater foreground/background separation than the random head.

Predicted depth still has texture imprint, road/sidewalk bands, blurred object boundaries, and incorrect building/distant-scene distances. The four unused train views retain RMSE14.29m and AbsRel.327; this is a mechanism/learning check, not accurate deployment depth.
display_limits: GT validity mask (including sky exclusion) is applied to all depth display columns for comparison. The black sky/borders in the panels are not a learned sky mask or proof of correctly predicted depth boundaries. Network forward receives RGB only.
limits: 24 updates on4 train images, 4 other train images only. No validation/heldout or Wall-IoU improvement claim.
CPU FP32 only; CUDA/BF16 memory, augmentation alignment and production integration remain untested. No extra training or automatic queue created.
